item.title: Nepal’s Gen Z protests one year on
item.description: September 8 marks a year since a Gen Z-led violent revolt against corruption in Nepal forced the then prime minister to resign. The protests were triggered when government tried to suspend many prominent social media platforms for failing to comply with new Nepalese A year on, and as the country still grapples with the devastation caused by deadly floods, Morgan Ayre looks back at how Nepal got to this point and the challenges that lie ahead. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: ‘Truly terrifying’: AfD election win sparks protests across Germany
item.description: The victory of the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) in Sunday's state election in Saxony-Anhalt sparked protests across Germany on Monday, as demonstrators called for a united front against the hardline anti-immigrant party. Some protesters call for the party, some of whose members have praised the Nazis, to be banned, but others say AfD's success is a result of a failure of mainstream political parties. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Dozens of young people congregated at Nepal’s burnt-out parliament building on Tuesday to mark the anniversary of deadly anti-corruption protests that toppled the former government. item.title: Tuesday briefing: What happens next after Germany’s far-right breakthrough?
item.description: In today’s newsletter: The AfD’s local election triumph has shocked Europe, and raised questions about how to counter the rising far right Good morning. It was, according to France’s European affairs minister, Benjamin Haddad, “a very grave moment for Europe”. item.description: El partido ultraderechista AfD ganó las elecciones regionales en Sajonia-Anhalt con el 44,5% de los votos, quedando al borde de la mayoría absoluta. El resultado abre la posibilidad de que el partido gobierne por primera vez un estado alemán, de ser así, podría ser un precedente del fortalecimiento de la derecha radical. item.title: Australia construye un sistema de alianzas en el Pacífico para mantener a China al margen
item.description: El Grand Pacific Hotel es una antigua institución colonial británica situada en el corazón de la capital de Fiyi. Las brisas tropicales soplan desde el puerto y atraviesan sus terrazas encaladas hasta llegar al parlamento, al otro lado de la calle. El 6 de julio, el primer ministro de Fiyi ofrecía allí un banquete en honor de su homólogo australiano para celebrar un nuevo pacto de defensa mutua entre ambos países. item.title: Canada’s retaliatory US tariffs set to take effect as trade dispute grows
item.description: Counter-measures covering several sectors come after Trump announced 50% tariffs on Canadian goods Canada is set to impose retaliatory tariffs on billions of dollars’ worth of American imports early on Tuesday, escalating a trade fight with its largest trading partner as tensions between US president Donald Trump and Canadian prime minister Mark Carney intensify. The tariffs, which take effect at 12.01am on Tuesday, will range from 15% to 50% and apply to products covering C$27.6bn in imports from the US. item.title: Tras la histórica victoria de AfD en Alemania, así reaccionan políticos y ciudadanos en las calles
item.description: Tras el triunfo de AfD en los comicios regionales de Sajonia-Anhalt, los dirigentes políticos reaccionaron al histórico resultado alcanzado por el partido de extrema derecha. Ulrich Siegmund se refirió a cómo podría alcanzar el apoyo necesario para convertirse en ministro presidente, ya que su partido quedó a solo tres escaños de la mayoría absoluta. Por su parte, el canciller Friedrich Merz reconoció la peor derrota histórica de la CDU, que gobernaba la región desde 1990. En las calles, los ciudadanos tienen una visión dividida. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: 'Polarised Brazil': Lula remains a ‘strong candidate’ despite the challenges of incumbency
item.description: François Picard is pleased to welcome Andreza Aruska de Souza Santos, Director of King’s Brazil Institute at the School of Global Affairs, King’s College London and Associate Professor in Brazil and Latin American Studies. According to Aruska, Brazil’s approaching elections can be viewed through the following prism: macroeconomic performance and political confidence are moving on different tracks. While headline indicators may suggest an economy performing relatively well, she argues that many Brazilians experience a much harsher reality shaped by the cost of living and a volatile job market. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: German chancellor vows to stay in office despite AfD triumph in state election
item.description: Friedrich Merz said his conservative CDU was shaken ‘to its very foundations’ after far-right victory in Saxony-Anhalt A “shocked” and chastened Friedrich Merz has vowed to stay in office despite the far right’s triumph in a state election that has brought anti-immigrant, pro-Kremlin politicians within striking distance of power. The German chancellor, appearing ashen-faced in front of reporters in Berlin, said on Monday that the landslide victory by the Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) in Saxony-Anhalt had shaken his conservative Christian Democratic Union (CDU) “to its very foundations”… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Informe desde Bruselas: preocupación en Europa tras el triunfo de AfD en Sajonia-Anhalt
item.description: Aunque no es común que los gobiernos europeos se pronuncien tras los resultados de unas elecciones en cualquier Estado miembro, el triunfo del partido AfD en las elecciones regionales de Sajonia-Anhalt, Alemania, despertó la preocupación de varios países de la Unión Europea. El auge de la extrema derecha impacta directamente al Gobierno federal de Friedrich Merz, pone en duda la estabilidad de la UE y coloca en la mira los próximos comicios en otros países. Un informe de nuestra corresponsal, Esther Herrera. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Europe’s centre fears nationalist wave after far-right AfD wins state in Germany
item.description: Saxony-Anhalt win part of wider trend driven by mainstream policy failures and gradual normalisation of far right ideas The numbers speak for themselves: Alternative für Deutschland (AfD), a party that dabbles in Nazi imagery, distinguishes between “biological” and “passport” Germans, and is too extreme even for France’s far-right leader Marine Le Pen, nearly doubled its score in Sunday’s state election in Saxony-Anhalt to 43.8% of the vote. Meanwhile, the centre-right CDU of the chancellor, Friedrich Merz, collapsed to 17.2%, less than half its total in the same race five years ago, and the… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: La izquierda y el centro de Francia, alarmados por el triunfo de AfD en Alemania
item.description: Cuando veas las barbas de tu vecino cortar, pon las tuyas a remojar. Este famoso refrán español resuena este lunes en la política francesa. Tanto la izquierda como el centro-derecha afín al presidente galo, Emmanuel Macron , reaccionaron con preocupación ante la victoria el domingo de la ultraderechista Alternativa para Alemania en las elecciones regionales de Sajonia-Anhalt, en el este de Alemania. Ven en la posibilidad de que la extrema derecha gobierne por primera vez en un 'land' una «señal alarmante» de cara a las presidenciales en Francia. Marine Le Pen afronta como favorita la primera… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.
